mechanism_of_action: Proposed to ameliorate NAFLD by regulating the FGF21-adiponectin axis.
efficacy_outcome: After 3 months, fish oil versus corn oil significantly reduced serum ALT (net change −5.4 ± 14.5 vs −0.25 ± 4.70 U/L; P=0.001) and triacylglycerol (−0.70 ± 1.10 vs 0.11 ± 1.04 mmol/L; P=0.018), decreased FGF21, and increased adiponectin.
